snippet.title: [Seaside Wash] Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.
👉Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4719020/Seaside_Wash/
